references.text: The prophecy that light comes to the righteous, while darkness covers the earth, can be seen as a spiritual parallel to the preparation of the wise and foolish virgins and the condition of their lamps.
The value of wisdom and the necessity of being prepared and having one's own supply of 'oil', which can be interpreted as wisdom or readiness, is reflected in the call to buy and not to borrow.
God's word as a lamp for the feet and a light on the path can symbolize the spiritual 'oil' that keeps the believers' 'lamps' burning.
